Title: Student registration and login
Acceptance criteria: Student can register/login; password is hashed; invalid login is rejected.

Title: Role and ownership protection
Acceptance criteria: Students cannot mutate inventory or access another student request.

Title: Equipment inventory CRUD
Acceptance criteria: Staff can add, read, edit and delete eligible individual assets.

Title: Browse and filter inventory
Acceptance criteria: Student can search and filter by category and availability.

Title: Borrowing request CRUD
Acceptance criteria: Student can create/read/edit/delete own eligible requests.

Title: Approve or reject requests
Acceptance criteria: Staff decisions update requests; only one asset loan is approved.

Title: Record returns
Acceptance criteria: Staff marks physical return; asset becomes available.

Title: User account management
Acceptance criteria: Own profile/password update and eligible student account deletion.

Title: API test evidence
Acceptance criteria: Run automated/Postman tests and capture team evidence.

Title: Team contract and logo
Acceptance criteria: 4-6 members agree, supply details, and sign contract.

Title: EDD version 1
Acceptance criteria: Review wireframes, add team identity and authenticated screenshots.

Title: Team repository
Acceptance criteria: Every member commits genuine work; add actual URL.

Title: Actual task board
Acceptance criteria: Import stories, assign owners, track progress; export current PDF.

Title: Slides and video
Acceptance criteria: Two required slides with real photos; 5-10 minute hosted demo.

Title: Transactional lending workflows
Acceptance criteria: Use replica-set transactions and audit/reconciliation for cross-record changes.

Title: Pagination and password recovery
Acceptance criteria: Bound lists; provide verified email/password recovery.
